invariants.description: f_ash = G_abh f_br - G_alh f_ls + G_ach (f_cp - 10)
f_asp = G_abp f_br + G_alp f_ls + G_acp (f_cp - 10)
f_asv = G_abv f_br + G_alv f_ls + G_acv (f_cp - 10)

bc_sweep.rationale: f_br over the full baroreceptor range f_min-f_max (Gee Table S.6), f_cp over 0-f_max,l, f_ls 0-30 Hz; zero-valued gains swept 0-1 / 0-2.5 (the other pathways' values); other gains x0.5-x2.

baseline.reason: intermediate neuronal population of the Gee 2023 reflex network: its firing rate is not measured on its own (parameters were identified from whole-system HR/elastance/ICN data), so there is no component-level data; checked against its exact static map. Validation belongs to the assembled closed-loop model (candidate: Gee 2023 Table 2 baseline SBP/DBP/HR/CO/EF and VNS % changes).
